claims.value: Dayhoff is a hybrid state-space-model transformer architecture with mixture-of-experts designed for protein sequence generation and modeling.
claims.evidence: The Dayhoff architecture is a hybrid of state-space Mamba layers and Transformer self-attention, interleaved with Mixture-of-Experts modules to maximize capacity while preserving efficiency.
It is not meant for natural language or other biological sequences, such as DNA sequences... This model should not be used to generate anything that is not a protein sequence
